title: Not given book within my genre
text: I ordered the box with 4 books a month and requested only 1 genre of Romance, I usually prefer paranormal romance but they don't let you get that specific but I was okay with that I enjoy reading different types of books as long as it has some romance in it. Sadly I was given 3 crime mystery books (no romance in those) and 1 romance novel. The re-used book box is a great idea and if I had actually received books within the genre I want to read.
label: negative
